# Color fixture provenance

All files in this directory are generated; none is copied from a third-party profile or dataset
distribution.

| File | Origin | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| `icc/veskra-srgb-v4.icc` | Generated by `veskra-color` (`IccProfile::srgb()`, writer in `crates/veskra-color/src/icc/writer.rs`) from the published IEC 61966-2.1 chromaticities, D65 white and sRGB curve parameters. Regenerate: `VESKRA_REGEN_COLOR_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p veskra-color --test icc_fixtures`. | Veskra project data (MIT OR Apache-2.0). The embedded `cprt` text reads "No copyright, use freely". |
| `icc/veskra-display-p3-v4.icc` | Same writer, Display P3 (SMPTE EG 432-1 primaries, D65, sRGB curve). | As above. |
| `icc/lcms2-builtin-srgb.icc` | Output of LittleCMS 2.19 `cmsCreate_sRGBProfile()` via Pillow 12.3.0 `ImageCms.createProfile("sRGB")`, written by `scripts/color/gen_oracle_fixtures.py`. Header creation date (bytes 24–35) normalized to 2026-01-01T00:00:00 for reproducibility; no other byte changed (Profile ID is zero in the original). | Machine-generated colorimetric data from an MIT-licensed library; the profile's own `cprt` reads "No copyright, use freely". Used only as a third-party test input. |
| `expected_conversions.json` | `scripts/color/gen_oracle_fixtures.py`: LittleCMS (Pillow ImageCms) transform outputs, colour-science Lab/CIEDE2000 values, profile validation results. Tool versions are recorded inside the file. | Generated test data (MIT OR Apache-2.0). |
| `srgb_swatches.csv` | Same script: 183 swatch RGB values chosen by Veskra + colour-science Lab D50. | Generated test data (MIT OR Apache-2.0). |
| `color_report.json` | `crates/veskra-color/tests/oracle.rs::color_report` with `VESKRA_WRITE_COLOR_REPORT=1`. | Generated test data (MIT OR Apache-2.0). |

The CIEDE2000 reference pairs typed into `crates/veskra-color/src/lab.rs` and the script are the
factual numeric values of Table 1 in G. Sharma, W. Wu, E. N. Dalal, "The CIEDE2000
color-difference formula: Implementation notes, supplementary test data, and mathematical
observations", *Color Research & Application* 30(1), 2005.

Third-party ICC profiles used for the optional local corpus test (`VESKRA_LOCAL_ICC_DIR`, e.g.
`/usr/share/color/icc/krita`, Elle Stone profiles under CC BY-SA 3.0 and others) are **not**
committed.
